description: Create a pending customer-paid Stripe Checkout from a quote_id returned by prepare_order, only after the customer explicitly approved the displayed plan and price and accepted the terms. Requires the customer's email and customer_confirmed=true, terms_accepted=true; returns a checkout URL, NOT a paid eSIM, and fulfilment starts only after verified payment. Reuse one idempotency_key per intended purchase, including retries, to avoid duplicate orders; use purchase for other supported payment methods.

customer_confirmed.description: true only if the customer explicitly confirmed this purchase.

email.description: Customer email; the eSIM and receipt are sent there.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per purchase (MCP). REST: send the Idempotency-Key header instead.

lang.description: Language for names and texts (default en).

terms_accepted.description: true only if the customer accepted immediate delivery and the loss of the withdrawal right.

name: create_checkout
title: Create checkout for the customer
